name: Franklin by Blockrun AI

hlido_opinion.headline: Franklin is an early-stage AI agent from Blockrun AI — the GitHub repository surface does not yet communicate enough to evaluate the product's scope or quality.
hlido_opinion.body: Franklin by Blockrun AI is a GitHub-hosted AI agent project. The name 'Franklin' and the Blockrun AI organisation name both suggest a deliberate product framing rather than a personal experiment, but the public surface at time of review is insufficient to determine what the agent actually does, who it is for, or whether it is production-ready. The repository exists and is public, which is the minimum bar for evaluation. Without a product website, documentation, demo, or README depth, Hlido's engine assigns the baseline FADING (40) score reflecting that the agent exists and is publicly evaluable but lacks the surrounding surface quality that buyers and agent-consumers need. Monitor for a product site and documentation as the next meaningful signal.

tier_rationale: FADING (40) — GitHub-only surface, no product site or documentation depth visible at review time. Organisational account (blockrunai) suggests intent, but the product surface does not yet support a higher evaluation.
what_it_does_well: Public GitHub repository accessible for direct inspection
Organisational account suggests more than solo-project scope
what_it_fails_at: No product website or landing page
No documentation or API contract visible
No evidence of users, deployments, or production use
best_for: Researchers who want to read source directly and evaluate the agent architecture
red_flags: Insufficient public surface to evaluate scope, capability, or stability.
